$comment: THE CANONICAL EN-AR TERMINOLOGY GLOSSARY NFR-039 NAMES (WBS-40.1 / DW-069, DEC-167 q1). One file, no mirror: docs/README.md §G, docs/governance/glossary.md and design-handoff/claude-design-input-package.md all point HERE, and this file points nowhere. The application's strings stay in locales/en.json and locales/ar.json; this file governs them through scripts/check-i18n-terms.mjs, which reads `terms` and `allowedVariants` and fails on any short English label carrying more than one Arabic rendering that is not a reviewed variant. EN definitions stay in docs/governance/glossary.md (DOC-049); this file carries TERMS. ⛔ EVERY `ar` VALUE AND EVERY `allowedVariants` ENTRY IS THE OPERATOR'S RULING (DEC-156 d3: the Arabic reviewer is the operator; DEC-165 n4: rulings come from ONE slate grouped by term) — an agent never fills one in from ar.json, because ar.json is the artefact this glossary is checked AGAINST and cannot also be the source (DW-069). `status: proposed` with `ar: null` means not yet ruled. `aliases` are the other English labels the same concept appears under in en.json, so the slate and the check can find every surface. Regenerate the slate with `node scripts/gen-i18n-term-slate.mjs`.
owner: operator (Arabic reviewer, DEC-156 d3); lead-secretary per DOC-049
